race.comment: COWBOYKICKEDFIVE (2) led and just failed to hang on last start over 1600m at Bairnsdale when well in the market to make it three minor placings from four runs this preparation. Has good early toe so he should be handy in the run, which can be an advantage here. GRADIVUS (10) missed the placings two starts back when resuming then ran a better race and finished 4.5 lengths away in fourth last time out over 1550m at Bordertown. This no easier, but what he does have on a few rivals is improvement to come and suited up to this trip. JULEP (7) hit the frame two starts ago at Mildura but ran below par last time when seventh and beaten 4 lengths over 2112m at Echuca. Looks well placed so expect a better run this time. MY ALPHA SONIC (3) will need luck from the draw but has been racing in stronger company than this of late. MISIL BEAUTY (8) is probably rising in grade a touch, but has been more consistent than most others here of late and draws perfectly.
